Test helpers to create and free a CRDS with mock gossip contact info entries.

# Purpose
Creates a test helper for `fd_crds_t` objects and fills them with mock contact info entries for use in unit tests. The [`create_test_crds_with_ci`](<#create_test_crds_with_ci>) function allocates aligned memory, creates and joins a CRDS instance with a mock gossip output context, then inserts a requested number of peer records with random public keys and random stake values. Each inserted peer is marked active with `fd_crds_peer_active`, so the returned CRDS object is ready for test cases that need populated peer state. The [`free_test_crds`](<#free_test_crds>) function releases the allocated CRDS memory with `free`.
